title: Nine Tables of Rain
subtitle: 咖啡馆与茶饮 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 咖啡馆与茶饮（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：咖啡馆与茶饮（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：café　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 café 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my mother was sent to open ① a café she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② café, meaning the room and not the coffee, was nine tables wide and was swept by whoever came last; a café, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ café in that street had the same awning, and the ④ café at the corner, meaning the one the widow ran and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened properly. A café, my grandmother said, is nine parts smoke and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the smoke is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ café was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the hours it filled and not the room. The ⑥ café, meaning the afternoon and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody sits in and nobody questions; a café, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a room and an afternoon. She said the afternoon is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ café had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the awning. The ⑧ café of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine tables and eleven years of sweeping; a café, she said, is either the one at the corner or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ café I remember is the one at the corner, which was sold in 1982 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ café, my grandmother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being sat in; every café, she said, is an afternoon that has agreed to look like a room. She said the afternoon was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 咖啡馆；小餐馆
B. n. 咖啡馆（指那间屋子本身，与咖啡相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a café 开／打开一家咖啡馆
D. n. 咖啡馆（指那条街上每一家）
E. n. 咖啡馆（指转角那一家）
F. n. 咖啡馆（抽象：它填满的那个下午）
G. n. 那个下午（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a café she could not name
The café, meaning the room and not the coffee
café was the whole of the afternoon
the café had become a photograph in a report
The café of the whole thing
A café, my grandmother said in 1986

answers.why: open a café 意为“开／打开一家咖啡馆”，1961 年母亲被派去开一家她说不出名字的咖啡馆。
café 意为“咖啡馆”，指那间屋子本身而不是咖啡，摆九张桌子，由最后走的人打扫。
café 指那条街上每一家咖啡馆，每一家都是同样的雨篷。
café 指转角那一家（寡妇经营的那一家），是唯一有人认真开门营业的。
café 意为“咖啡馆”，抽象指它填满的那个下午，父亲说 café 就是那个下午的全部。
café 为抽象用法，指那个下午本身，是镇上人人都坐着、却没人质疑的东西。
café 意为“咖啡馆、小餐馆”，到 1977 年这家 café 成了报告里的一张照片。
café 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九张桌子和十一年的打扫。
café 意为“咖啡馆”，我记得的是转角那一家，1982 年转手，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
café 为抽象总称，祖母说咖啡馆是唯一会因为有人坐下来而变好的地方。
